review.name: Leti
review.comment: The mascarpone cream is a game changer. Not too sweet, just perfect!

review.name: Angela
review.comment: Best brownies in Croydon. So fudgy and rich.

review.name: Maria
review.comment: The sponge was incredibly moist. I didn't miss the buttercream at all!

review.name: Joao
review.comment: Authentic, crispy, and delicious. Reminded me of my travels.

review.name: Mary
review.comment: Finally a bakery that doesn't use heavy buttercream. The whipped cream cheese frosting is divine.

review.name: Yonna
review.comment: Got a custom cake for my daughter's birthday. Looked beautiful and tasted even better.

review.name: Marianna
review.comment: The macaroons are so delicate and coconutty. Absolutely love them.

review.name: Thiago
review.comment: Great local bakery on Church Street. The tray bakes are a weekend staple for my family.

review.name: Yara
review.comment: The cake wasn't cloyingly sweet, which is exactly what I look for. The flavor essences really shine through.

review.name: Sam
review.comment: Lovely young family running this place. Their loaves are fresh and perfect for breakfast.

review.name: Emma
review.comment: I despise standard buttercream, so finding Fussy Baby Cakes was a dream come true.

review.name: Liam
review.comment: The mango cake was a masterpiece. Fresh, fruity, and incredibly light.

review.name: Sophia
review.comment: Bought a box of cupcakes. The vegan cream alternative is indistinguishable from the real thing!

review.name: Noah
review.comment: Unbelievable texture on the cakes. Whatever their secret technique is, it works perfectly.

review.name: Olivia
review.comment: The soft cheese cream frosting pairs perfectly with their rich chocolate sponge.

review.name: James
review.comment: Excellent customer service and the tray bakes are top notch.

review.name: Chloe
review.comment: It fed the whole party and everyone asked where it was from. Highly recommend!

review.name: Daniel
review.comment: The brownies have the perfect crinkly top and gooey center.

review.name: Mia
review.comment: Such a beautiful addition to Croydon. Their bakes always feel made with love.

review.name: Lucas
review.comment: The vegan options are incredible. Best vegan cake I've had in South London.

review.name: Ava
review.comment: The mascarpone finish on the cake makes it feel so luxurious and premium.

review.name: Benjamin
review.comment: Delicious muffins! Perfect with my morning coffee.

review.name: Isabella
review.comment: Tried the Azerbaijani baklava at their stall. So nutty, syrupy, and crisp.

review.name: Henry
review.comment: No heavy sugar syrups, just pure flavor. Highly recommend their bespoke cakes.

review.name: Grace
review.comment: A wonderful family business. The custom cake we got was the highlight of the event.
